message.subject: GPC’s have a shorter filter and more tobacco
message.content: I remember writing and responding to your mailing list before. I also remember those beautiful recipes you sent to our address: 7276 “A” Radbourne Road, Upper Darby, PA. 19082. I still have the recipes. Thank you so much for those offers. I believe smokers still have trouble on this earth - our “home.” I tried with the free carton offer but have not succeeded yet.
